implementation.click: Puppeteer page.click; isTrusted is asserted separately from visibility.
implementation.destination: Native CSSOM scrollIntoView center/nearest in an inert scriptless local geometric reference, with scroll-margin/scroll-padding. Independent expected destination comes from real identical fixture DOM in another page, not from the helper reference.
implementation.requestOrigin: Nearest destination is based on the request origin; intermediate pauses do not redefine successful completion.
implementation.dynamicGeometry: Reevaluate document/viewport/target dimensions and geometry; reset stability, recompute native destination and issue an updated native request when needed.
implementation.stability: Both scroll axes, target box and document dimensions must match for three rAF samples (two stable intervals) at the destination.
implementation.nativeEnd: Real onscrollend capability is asserted. Listener before request; trusted document/root event after request/last scroll, at matching final position. No-motion checks both X/Y.
implementation.visibility: Original connected identity, disabled/inert, own and ancestor opacity/display/content-visibility, computed visibility and checkVisibility, nonempty box, complete viewport and center hit-test.
implementation.cleanup: Scroll listener/native-end listener/reference removed on success, timeout and synchronous request failure; handle disposed.
implementation.diagnostics: Timeout remains TimeoutError/4000ms. error.interaction identifies destination, detached, visual or event cause; no timeout is converted to success.
implementation.scopeLimit: Document scrolling in current fixtures/flows only; not a universal implementation for nested scrollers, scroll-snap, all CSS layouts/transformations, app iframes or other engines.

fourFindings.entryEvidence: Vertical native 435 versus manual 495; horizontal margin/padding native 830 versus border-only nearest 710. OFF 3 already passed entry and has a separate explicit margin-omission mutant RED.
fourFindings.solution: Delegate the effective destination to native CSSOM with margins/paddings, preserving final destination + stability + hit-test.

fourFindings.entryEvidence: Maximum shrinks 1190->390, making initial 795 unreachable; geometry moves native destination 495->695; old visible pause 495 must not release.
fourFindings.solution: Reevaluate geometry/limits and retarget with native requests; require final stable state.

fourFindings.entryEvidence: Ancestor opacity0 accepted despite own1 and BUTTON hit; original replacement accepted. Hidden visibility and coverage already blocked at entry; display:none blocked but did not recover.
fourFindings.solution: Ancestors + native visibility + original connected identity + full viewport + hit-test, independently of trusted input. Existing protections explicitly distinguished from fixed defects.

fourFindings.entryEvidence: Y ready could mark native operation done while X/event still pending; diagonal visible pause x710/y495 is not final x830/y495.
fourFindings.solution: No-motion and destination account for both axes; require native event in ON and final stability in both modes.

scrollCounterfactual.interpretation: Not every entry failure is a missing behavioral protection. Cases8/11 and OFF3/OFF12 were GREEN at entry; synthetic RED sensitivity is separate. Case15 RED is diagnostic evidence, not failure to block. Case9 RED is recovery, not hidden-state acceptance. Full failure states and synthetic failures are in the evidence archive.

fixtureObservationV1.cause: atFinal incorrectly demanded a pending native callback after the visual test deliberately delivered it. Browser had already reached the destination and delivered the trusted event. Test-fixture observation bug, not a timeout workaround.
fixtureObservationV1.correction: Parameterize whether event delivery is held. For visual blockers assert real native event AND delivered > 0; preserve all readiness/blocking assertions and timeout4000.

nearestOriginV3.cause: Extra barrier resumed scroll-margin/inline-nearest from an already fully visible border box. Chromium legitimately picked no movement at710, whereas the fixture expected830 from an independent control starting at0.
nearestOriginV3.correction: For new case3 pause while the border is still partially outside (x650). Replace that checkpoint's full-viewport/hit expectations with explicit partial-viewport assertions, rather than requiring a second nearest request from a fully visible border. Keep fully visible intermediate pauses in cases4/13/14. Final native destination remains830, with all final readiness/stability/event/visibility assertions unchanged. The preexisting 10-case matrix and its 38 assertions remain byte-exact as a prefix. An explicit margin-omission synthetic mutant also fails OFF3, which passed with the exact entry helper.
